name: ui_tap
description: Tap a UI element on a connected device by resource-id, text, or content-description. First discovers elements via uiautomator dump, finds the matching element, then taps its center coordinates. Supports partial resource-id matching. Returns the tapped coordinates and matched element info.

content_desc.description: Content-description (accessibility label) of the element to tap. Case-insensitive substring by default; set exact=true for full-string equality.

coords.description: Direct [x, y] SCREEN-SPACE coordinates to tap, bypassing element search

device_id.description: Device ID (optional if only one device connected)

exact.description: Match id/text/content_desc by full-string equality (case-insensitive) instead of the default substring match.

id.description: Resource ID of the element to tap. Case-insensitive substring of the simple id (text after ':id/') by default, e.g. 'search_input' matches 'com.android.app:id/search_input'. Set exact=true for full-id equality.

text.description: Visible text of the element to tap. Case-insensitive substring by default (e.g. 'SAVE' also matches 'Saved notes:'); set exact=true for full-string equality.

arguments.description: Generated MCP request struct for this tool.
arguments.title: UiTapRequest
